sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def dotpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
def state():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top_solid = all(a[r][c]=='b' for r in range(20,24) for c in range(18,22))
    redV = all(a[r][18]=='R' for r in range(24,30))
    return ('V' if redV else 'H'), ('A' if top_solid else 'B')
def goto(t):
    d=dotpos(); m=[]
    m+= ['DOWN']*((t[0]-d[0])//2)+['UP']*((d[0]-t[0])//2)
    m+= ['RIGHT']*((t[1]-d[1])//2)+['LEFT']*((d[1]-t[1])//2)
    if m: action(m)
order=[(38,8),(38,10),(38,12),(40,12),(42,12),(42,10),(42,8),(40,8),(40,10)]
found=False
# Cycle 4 states, scanning 9 dot positions each
for st in range(4):
    print("STATE",state(),"dot",dotpos())
    for t in order:
        goto(t)
        if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
            print("DONE at",t,state()); found=True; break
    if found: break
    # advance to next piece state
    if state()==('H','A'): action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':49}])   # -> H,B
    elif state()==('H','B'): action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':49}])  # -> V,B
    elif state()==('V','B'): action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':49}])   # -> V,A
print("found:",found,"final state",state(),"dot",dotpos())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
